notes.title: Gameplay Update v 0.1.9
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Version 0.1.9 brings a lot of changes and updates to the Demo and Playtest version of Lumina Veil. Playtesters now have access to Chapter 3 and can play through the entire chapter, just keep in mind that it still includes some placeholder assets and certain features are not fully balanced yet. As for the Demo, all gameplay changes from the Playtest version are now included, featuring an improved dodging system, various combat and control tweaks, and a chapter select feature. Chapter 3 is set to release this Summer, which isn’t too far off.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/2fb42b32dc71f954f88aae927fb6f976c6fb48b6.jpg[/img]

For more information you can follow me on X [url=https://x.com/rori_richard_]Twitter/X[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/mZGesEZfTA]join our discord[/url].

notes.title: Language Update v 0.1.7 Demo C2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

I've released a new update for the Demo and the Playtest version of Lumina Veil. The whole game is now translated to German. The language can be switched anytime from the options menu. Also a new welcome screen at the first startup will ask you to set important settings like language, gamma correction and visual quality.

Playtesters can now enter a new area in Chapter 3 and continue exploring the new challenges. There is also a new cutscene to discover, I'm curious what you think about the new story beats.

notes.title: Gameplay Update v 0.1.64 Demo C2
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

This update brings numerous gameplay enhancements based on feedback from the playtest version. Combat controls have been refined for a smoother, more fluid experience. The AI of the basic enemy type has been reworked, making it more responsive and engaging. Additionally, various systems have been fine-tuned to make it a fairer challenge. Switching between melee and ranged combat is now more seamless, and notes are better organized by area for easier reference.

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you so much for following the development of Lumina Veil! If you haven’t had the chance to try out the demo featuring Chapters 1 and 2, now is the perfect time to dive in! You can download the demo on the store page and start playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/5769bccac7f18bc2ca9ef0849c82adb62e6e9695.png[/img]

I’m excited to share updates on Chapter 3, which is progressing well. This chapter introduces a special type of enemy that I’m actively testing to ensure the gameplay balance feels just right. Additionally, for the first time, you’ll be able to step outside your apartment and explore what the “real” world truly looks like.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/455fbb757e6c33e5126590fcc4730d2c3f661539.png[/img]

Based on feedback, I’ve also expanded the lore elements. Many of you enjoyed diving into the game’s backstory, so I’ve added more memo pages and implemented a system to group these documents in your inventory by area for better organization.

While working on Chapter 3’s content, I also revisited the basic controls to refine them based on playtesters input. These tweaks are still in progress but will be included in the next version of the playtest build.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/0f1f7018e5b318532c9e155a72bcf037b576ba15.png[/img]

Thank you again for your incredible support and enthusiasm. Stay tuned for more updates!

For more information you can follow me on X [url=https://x.com/rori_richard_]Twitter/X[/url] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/mZGesEZfTA]join our discord[/url].

notes.title: Development Update
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Just wanted to drop a quick update on the progress of Lumina Veil. Things have been going really well on the development front!

I've been making good progress on expanding the game world, adding new areas to explore, and even introducing a rainy outdoor environment. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/2c4d9bbc8e9d4237e3718fcece80118624bb7348.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/9e62c52243f41b78866483c9e8c6dbdf66171aa1.png[/img]

In terms of gameplay, I’ve finally implemented a new ranged weapon that will make combat more interesting, as long as you find enough ammo. To make good use of the new weapon there are also new enemies to shoot at.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/dd0f6e3fc01786c3f232d7f9952b635519a98521.png[/img]

I'm also very thankful for all the support and encouragement I've received from the community. Interacting with players and horror fans is a huge motivation boost, that helps me a lot on keeping up the work.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44891629/243535b9e7396c3f9607753a23a4a6817a92708c.png[/img]

As promised, I'll be adding new content to the demo for free, so keep an eye out for updates and be sure to spread the word!

For those who want to stay updated on all things, you can follow me on Twitter "@rori_richard_" for regular updates, or join my Discord for more in-depth dev diary entries and behind-the-scenes insights.

Thanks again for your ongoing support, and I can't wait to share more exciting developments with you soon!

notes.title: Feedback Demo Update
notes.notes:
First of all, thank you so much for checking out the demo of Lumina Veil. It's a solo project developed by me alone, and getting feedback is a crucial part of continuing development. I've implemented a few changes to the demo to make the game more fun and accessible. The demo will now have the version number 0.0.4. Keep in mind that more content will come to the demo as development continues, and I plan to release the full game for free once it is done.
